THE FAUNA AND FLORA PROTECTION ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 469)

Order under Subsection (2) of Section 2

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by subsection (2) of section 2 of the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance (Chapter 469), I, Hettithanthri Patabendige Dammika, Minister of Environment do by this Order declare the area of land described in the Schedule hereto to be a Sanctuary for the purposes of the aforesaid Ordinance and further declare that such Sanctuary shall be known as the “Nikkandupola Sanctuary”.

Hettithanthri Patabendige Dammika, Minister of Environment.Colombo,04th June, 2025.

SCHEDULE

Limits of the Area of Land Comprising The Nikkandupola Sanctuary

All that area of land depicted in the map of the Department of Wildlife Conservation dated 02/05/2025, containing in extent 13.14 hectares, situated within the streamflow, stream banks and riparian corridors of the stream flowed from Rabbidigala to Hapugoda in the Village of Nikkandupola, Galapitamada in the Warakapola Divisional Secretary's Division in the Administrative District of Kegalle in the Sabaragamuwa Province and bounded by the GPS Coordinates specified hereunder, (Mode of Survey: GPS Coordinates EPSG: 5234):-
